summary: Completed iteration 2 regression testing for the portfolio. Backend tests, production build, desktop/mobile loading, clipboard fallback, inquiry validation, successful inquiry submission, and mobile navigation passed.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST-prefixed inquiries through the regression API and UI flows; the inquiry endpoint has no public read/delete route for cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested iteration 2 checks passed against the public preview URL. No auth flow applies and no APIs were mocked. The initial browser assertion was case-sensitive, but a corrected case-insensitive check confirmed the visible MESSAGE SENT state and HTTP 200 response.
rca of the issue: The prior iteration's clipboard and blank project-type issues are resolved. Clipboard fallback now reaches success feedback when navigator.clipboard is unavailable; the required project-type select and client-side check prevent blank submissions before POST.
